## Figures

- **Outpatient Medical (Number of Properties):** 262
  - Source: `documents/report.md` (Annual Report, page 61)

  - Source: `documents/report.md` (Annual Report, page 61)

  - Source: `documents/report.md` (Annual Report, page 61)
- **Outpatient Medical (Net Operating Income (NOI)):** $380,264
  - Source: `documents/report.md` (Annual Report, page 61)

To determine the percentage of outpatient medical properties relative to the total number of properties:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Number of Outpatient Medical Properties}}{\text{Total Number of Properties}} \right) \times 100 \]

By number of properties, outpatient medical was approximately 19.95% of the total.
